What was your role in AI data operations at Instawork, and why does quality assurance matter in AI?

Aero_India_Queue_Triage.Situation: At Aero India 2025 (Air Force Station Yelahanka), peak visitor arrival created a severe bottleneck at the primary delegation gate, risking security delays for VIP international defense delegates.
Aero_India_Queue_Triage.Task: As Ground Operations & Protocol Lead for Salt in My Coca, I had to immediately eliminate the backlog while maintaining 100% adherence to defense access protocols.
Aero_India_Queue_Triage.Action: I deployed a staged triage model: stationed crew 50 meters ahead to pre-scan RFID credentials, created a segregated express lane for defense dignitaries, and redirected uncredentialed visitors to secondary holding zones.
Aero_India_Queue_Triage.Result: Queue throughput increased by 40%, clearing the bottleneck in under 12 minutes with zero security breaches and on-time opening praised by organizers.

Puma_Brand_Activation_SLA.Situation: During a high-visibility Puma sports activation in central Bengaluru, an audiovisual fabrication vendor arrived 90 minutes behind schedule.
Puma_Brand_Activation_SLA.Task: Ensure full stage and POS readiness before the 10:00 AM retail launch without compromising safety standards.
Puma_Brand_Activation_SLA.Action: Invoked the contingency clause in the vendor SLA, parallel-tracked electrical testing with staging crew, and reassigned 6 crew members to expedite unboxing and equipment mounting.
Puma_Brand_Activation_SLA.Result: Completed full setup 15 minutes before doors opened. The activation ran seamlessly with zero shrinkage and 100% retail customer satisfaction.

Instawork_AI_Precision.Situation: Operational shift logs required rapid annotation to train internal AI allocation algorithms, with an error tolerance threshold below 2%.
Instawork_AI_Precision.Task: Achieve high-velocity throughput while maintaining top-tier benchmark precision.
Instawork_AI_Precision.Action: Constructed a standardized edge-case reference sheet for ambiguous shift logs and introduced a two-pass spot-check validation routine.
Instawork_AI_Precision.Result: Maintained a 99.4% accuracy rate across 10,000+ data points, serving as a quality benchmark for incoming team members.
